input_policy.aim_exit: Release only aim-owned fight state; exploration resumes if no other action requires fight
input_policy.crouch: Same mode and weapon selection contract, stance-specific animation

item_invariants: Every rifle and magazine has one stable instance identity
Each instance has exactly one authoritative location
An inserted magazine is not simultaneously a backpack spare
Accepted shots are the only round-consuming operation in this first slice
Empty magazine and no magazine are distinct
No magazine commits, ammo deductions or damage writes in the weapon AnimBP
Spare magazine selection excludes reserved, inaccessible, incompatible or empty magazines

beats.label: DrawAttach
beats.weapon_requirement: Attach rifle without competing transform writers

beats.label: WeaponReady
beats.inventory_effect: Publish usable active item/profile exactly once

beats.label: ShotAccepted
beats.inventory_effect: Debit exactly one round once for ShotId; validate active weapon and magazine
beats.character_requirement: Fire/recoil presentation aligned with accepted shot
beats.weapon_requirement: Mechanical cycle and muzzle cues for same ShotId

beats.inventory_effect: None; release firing lock when complete
beats.character_requirement: Bolt/charging/ready movement complete if required by chosen clip
beats.weapon_requirement: Ready/empty-state mechanics agree with committed magazine

beats.label: ActionEndedOrCancelled

beat_naming_status: Semantic labels only; final GameplayTag names must be mapped to existing project conventions before registration

Muzzle.parent_frame: stable receiver/barrel frame; compensator geometry bone is a candidate
Muzzle.placement: bore exit with an agreed forward axis; exact transform requires visual validation
Muzzle.rule: correct socket transform determines emission location; parent bone name alone does not

CasingEject.parent_frame: stable frame at ejection port; do not infer the moving part's role from the name ejector alone
CasingEject.placement: requires visual placement and ejection-direction review

Magwell.parent_frame: stable visible receiver frame, e.g. weapon hand_r or verified static receiver geometry bone
Magwell.rule: independent of the removable/hidden magazine subtree; magazine insertion offset accounts for the prop pivot

weapon_presentation_contract.magazine_visibility: No duplicate built-in/prop representation of the same magazine; different magazine instances may be visible simultaneously
weapon_presentation_contract.built_in_magazine_hiding: Chosen structural method: HideBoneByName(UE4_M16_MagazMod,PBO_None); isolated 100percent influences verified from exported LOD0. Keep the separate Magwell prop attachment outside the hidden subtree. Runtime visual verification remains pending.
weapon_presentation_contract.mechanism_motion: Author only verified moving parts for each action; do not automatically cycle every mechanism bone on every shot
weapon_presentation_contract.action_end_pose: Restore the committed magazine and selected mechanism/fire-mode presentation, rather than resetting all parts blindly to reference pose

reload_policy.selection: Fullest eligible compatible spare, stable identity tie-break
reload_policy.no_inserted_magazine: Can load a compatible spare; no old-mag return space needed
reload_policy.retention: Keep partial and empty old magazines
reload_policy.storage_failure: Reject before playback; never silently drop old magazine
reload_policy.commit: Magazine insertion beat, once per ActionId
reload_policy.cancel_before_commit: Original item locations and rounds retained; restore visuals
reload_policy.cancel_after_commit: Completed swap retained; release remaining locks
reload_policy.stance_change: Proposed cancellation through same pre/post-commit rules until stance transitions during reload are validated
reload_policy.chamber_plus_one: Deferred proposal; no separate chamber model in first slice

implementation_priority.user_decision: Major gameplay systems first; use existing rifle skeletal mesh as-is initially
